description_en: Associates signatures with a template. After signatures are associated with a template, the SMS service specifications of the template are applied when the template is used to send messages
description_zh: 新增模版关联签名。给模板关联的签名，后续使用这个模板发送时，都会应用模板对应的短信服务规格
name: AddTemplateSignRel

parameters.help_en: The signature names. Separate multiple signature names with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 签名名称，如有多个签名名称，请使用英文逗号(,)分隔
parameters.name: sign_names

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The details about the access denial. This parameter is returned only when the RAM permission verification fails
AccessDeniedDetail.description_zh: 访问被拒绝详细信息，只有RAM校验失败才会返回此字段

Message.description_en:
The reason why the operation failed. Examples:

The status of signature * is "unavailable" and cannot be associated with a template.
Signature * does not exist.
Signature * is already associated with the template. No repeated association is required.
A template must be associated with at least one signature
Message.description_zh:
操作失败的原因。例如：

签名*状态为“不可用”，不允许关联模板；
签名*不存在
签名*已关联模板，无需重复关联
模板必须关联至少1个签名
Message.example: 模板必须关联至少1个签名

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. It is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request and can be used to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. If any signature in the signature list fails, the entire operation fails. Valid values:

true: The call was successful.

false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
调用接口是否成功。签名清单中，任一签名失败，则本次操作均失败。取值：

true：调用成功。

false：调用失败
